title: Fix wordram-ntt-kernel VERIFY.json input path (unbreaks CI planner)
body:
Since #5466, `research/wordram-ntt-kernel/VERIFY.json` declares the input `"MANIFEST.json"`. The CI planner (`scripts/research_package.py` → `require_tracked_input`) needs an exact Git-tracked repo path, so the onboarding tests `test_research_matrix_batches` (`test_grouped_cli_output_keeps_total_package_count`, `test_nested_workflow_change_selects_every_registered_package`) now fail on the **plan** job of every new PR (e.g. #5553, #5556).

One-line fix: `"MANIFEST.json"` → `"research/wordram-ntt-kernel/MANIFEST.json"`. No scientific change. Locally `python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_research_matrix_batches` passes (5 tests).
